show the second item of the servers array in project/Config.plist

items.request: Print duplicate UUID fields from unified-log.ndjson with occurrence counts.

candidates.command: grep -oE '"[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}"' unified-log.ndjson | tr -d '"' | sort | uniq -c | awk '$1 > 1 {print $1, $2}'
grep -E -o -i '"(uuid|UUID)"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]+"' unified-log.ndjson | sed 's/.*"\([^"]*\)"$/\1/' | sort | uniq -c | awk '$1 > 1 {print $1, $2}' | sort -nr
grep -oiE '[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}' unified-log.ndjson | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | sort | uniq -c | awk '$1 > 1'

items.request: Spotlight-find video clips with codec H.264 under ~/Movies/test-set.
does disk4s1 have a volume uuid show it

candidates.command: diskutil info disk4s1 | grep 'Volume UUID:' || echo 'No volume UUID'
diskutil info disk4s1 | grep -i 'Volume UUID' || echo 'No Volume UUID found'

items.request: which interfaces have ipv6 link local addreses

candidates.command: ifconfig -a | awk '/^[a-zA-Z0-9]+:/ {iface=$1; sub(/:$/, "", iface)} /inet6 fe80:/ {print iface}' | sort -u
ifconfig -a | awk '/^[a-z0-9]+:/ {iface=$1; sub(/:$/,"",iface)} /inet6 fe80/ {print iface}' | sort -u
ifconfig -a | awk 'BEGIN{iface=""} /^[^[:space:]]/{iface=$1; sub(/:$/,"",iface)} /^[[:space:]]+inet6 fe80:/{if(!seen[iface]++) print iface}'
ifconfig -a | awk '/^[a-z][a-z0-9]*:/ {iface=$1; sub(/:$/, "", iface)} /inet6 fe80/ {print iface}' | sort -u

items.request: Please show the number of open Terminal windows.

candidates.command: osascript -e 'if application "Terminal" is running then' -e 'tell application "Terminal" to count windows' -e 'else' -e '0' -e 'end if'
pgrep -x Terminal >/dev/null && osascript -e 'tell application "Terminal" to count windows' || echo 0
osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to count windows of every process whose name is "Terminal"'

items.request: Show Finder's locked property for final.pdf.

candidates.command: osascript -e 'on run argv' -e 'set f to (POSIX file (item 1 of argv)) as alias' -e 'tell application "Finder" to get locked of file f' -e 'end run' "$(pwd)/final.pdf"
osascript -e 'tell application "Finder" to get locked of (POSIX file ((do shell script "pwd") & "/final.pdf") as alias)'
GetFileInfo -a final.pdf | grep -qw locked && echo true || echo false
osascript -e 'set cwd to do shell script "pwd"' -e 'tell application "Finder" to get locked of (file "final.pdf" of folder (POSIX file cwd as alias))'
